description: Sample C source code demonstrating how to call the Qhull library functions for convex hull, Delaunay triangulation, and halfspace intersection. Contains functions for constructing geometric objects, running multiple Qhull operations, and error handling.

methods.name: print_summary
methods.description: Outputs the number of vertices and facets, along with facet normals.

methods.name: makecube
methods.description: Initializes points to vertices of a hypercube.

methods.name: adddiamond
methods.description: Adds a diamond shape to the convex hull by inserting points.

methods.name: makeDelaunay
methods.description: Sets points for 3D Delaunay triangulation by projecting onto a paraboloid.

methods.name: addDelaunay
methods.description: Adds points to an existing Delaunay triangulation.

methods.name: findDelaunay
methods.description: Finds the Delaunay triangle or adjacent triangle closest to a point.

methods.name: makehalf
methods.description: Creates halfspaces representing a diamond shape.

methods.name: addhalf
methods.description: Adds halfspaces for a cube to the intersection.
